documents.document: subscription BookingMachineChanged($id: UUID!) { bookingChanged(id: $id) { rowId revision state context { passport seat } dueAt dueAtKnown gone reload problem { code message } } }

mutation BookingCheckIn($id: UUID!, $input: BookingCheckInInput!, $requestId: String!, $clientResult: String) { machines { booking { checkIn(id: $id, input: $input, requestId: $requestId, clientResult: $clientResult) { id revision state context { passport seat } dueAt dueAtKnown problem { code message } invokedRun { runId } } } } }

query BookingGet($id: UUID!) { machines { booking { get(id: $id) { id revision state context { passport seat } dueAt dueAtKnown problem { code message } invokedRun { runId } } } } }

mutation BookingGivePassport($id: UUID!, $input: BookingGivePassportInput!, $requestId: String!, $clientResult: String) { machines { booking { givePassport(id: $id, input: $input, requestId: $requestId, clientResult: $clientResult) { id revision state context { passport seat } dueAt dueAtKnown problem { code message } invokedRun { runId } } } } }

mutation BookingStart($requestId: String!) { machines { booking { start(requestId: $requestId) { id revision state context { passport seat } dueAt dueAtKnown problem { code message } invokedRun { runId } } } } }
subscription DeskMachineChanged($id: UUID!) { deskChanged(id: $id) { rowId revision state dueAt dueAtKnown gone reload problem { code message } } }

mutation DeskCloseGate($id: UUID!, $requestId: String!, $clientResult: String) { machines { desk { closeGate(id: $id, requestId: $requestId, clientResult: $clientResult) { id revision state dueAt dueAtKnown problem { code message } } } } }
mutation DeskDiscard($id: UUID!, $requestId: String!) { machines { desk { discard(id: $id, requestId: $requestId) { id discarded problem { code message } } } } }
query DeskGet($id: UUID!) { machines { desk { get(id: $id) { id revision state dueAt dueAtKnown problem { code message } } } } }

mutation DeskOpenDesk($id: UUID!, $requestId: String!, $clientResult: String) { machines { desk { openDesk(id: $id, requestId: $requestId, clientResult: $clientResult) { id revision state dueAt dueAtKnown problem { code message } } } } }
mutation DeskStart($requestId: String!) { machines { desk { start(requestId: $requestId) { id revision state dueAt dueAtKnown problem { code message } } } } }

  seat: String
}

input BookingGivePassportInput {
  passport: String
}

"One event of the push of 'booking': the instance's whole snapshot with its revision, in the types its get answers, or the end of the stream."
type BookingMachineChange {
  "The incarnation of the instance the stream follows."
  rowId: Long @cost(weight: "10")
  "The snapshot's revision. Drop an event at or below the revision you hold: each is whole, so a skipped revision loses nothing."
  revision: Long @cost(weight: "10")
  "The state the instance is in, or null on an event that carries no snapshot."
  state: BookingMachineState @cost(weight: "10")
  "The instance's context, as get answers it, or null on an event that carries no snapshot."
  context: BookingMachineContext @cost(weight: "10")
  "When the timer of the state the instance is in fires, or null."
  dueAt: DateTime @cost(weight: "10")
  "Whether dueAt can be trusted. A push is the row as it is now, so it always can; the field is here so a push and a get decode with one type."
  dueAtKnown: Boolean! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The instance was deleted or expired. The last event of the stream."
  gone: Boolean! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Read the instance again: this event does not stand for it. A skipped revision never sets it."
  reload: Boolean! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Why the stream was refused or ended, or null. The last event of the stream."
  problem: SnapshotProblem @cost(weight: "10")
}

"The context of an instance of 'booking': every field any of its states declares, null where the state the instance is in does not hold it."
type BookingMachineContext {
  passport: String @cost(weight: "10")
  seat: String @cost(weight: "10")
}

"An instance of 'booking' as the server stored it, or the problem the operation was refused with."
type BookingMachineResult {
  "The instance's id."
  id: UUID @cost(weight: "10")
  "The instance's revision, bumped by every write. It travels beside the snapshot, never in it."
  revision: Long @cost(weight: "10")
  state: BookingMachineState @cost(weight: "10")
  context: BookingMachineContext @cost(weight: "10")
  "When the timer of the state the instance is in fires, or null when that state has no timer or the server cleared it. Says nothing when dueAtKnown is false."
  dueAt: DateTime @cost(weight: "10")
  "False when the answer replays a request the instance has moved past since: the server cannot know that state's due time, so dueAt is null and means nothing. Treat dueAt as absent then."
  dueAtKnown: Boolean! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Why the operation was refused, or null when it was not."
  problem: SnapshotProblem @cost(weight: "10")
  "The run this instance's current state queued, while it sits in that state; null otherwise. Only the instance's owner sees it."
  invokedRun: MachineInvokedRun @cost(weight: "10")
}

"The states of 'booking', named as the machine declares them."

  Booked

  Missed

  Open

"""
Every code a machine operation is refused with, by the engine, the draft service, the effect runner or the API. It
is one closed set: the engines' corpora, the GraphQL RefusalCode enum and the TypeScript package's
RefusalCode all hold these members, and each travels as its RefusalCode) spelling,
such as GUARD_FAILED.
"""
enum RefusalCode {
  "No transition is wired from the current state on the given trigger (or the state/trigger token is unknown)."
  NO_TRANSITION
  "A transition exists but its guard rejected the supplied input."
  GUARD_FAILED
  """
  A context fails its state's validator: produced by a transition (a reducer bug), or found in a stored or
  submitted snapshot.
  """
  INVALID_CONTEXT
  "An unexpected error was caught inside the engine. Surfaced as a refusal so the caller never sees an exception."
  INTERNAL_ERROR
  "The trigger input does not match the trigger's declared input schema."
  INVALID_INPUT
  "The trigger is an invoked train's outcome, which only the outcome path applies, never an advance."
  OUTCOME_BOUND
  "The trigger is a state's timer, which only the server fires, never an advance."
  TIMER_BOUND
  "The trigger input or the resulting snapshot is past the snapshot size cap."
  TOO_LARGE
  """
  A refusal of discard: the instance is in a state only the server puts it in (a committed state, an
  effect's target, a state that invokes a train, a state an invoked train's outcome reaches, or the target of an
  event gated by a role or a policy), or an effect on it is running or recording its result.
  """
  DISCARD_NOT_ALLOWED
  """
  An effect is pending on the instance: every other write to it waits until the effect is recorded or has
  failed. Retry once it has finished.
  """
  EFFECT_IN_PROGRESS
  "Stored or submitted JSON was not valid JSON, was not an object, or was missing a required field."
  MALFORMED
  "The snapshot or the request names a machine this host does not serve."
  UNKNOWN_MACHINE
  "The snapshot was produced against a different definition version."
  VERSION_MISMATCH
  "The snapshot's state token is not a state of this machine."
  UNKNOWN_STATE
  "The caller does not meet the rule the event, start or read declares."
  FORBIDDEN
  "The request id was already used for a different request."
  REQUEST_ID_REUSED
  "The trigger runs the machine's irreversible effect from this state, so only a send fires it, never an advance."
  EFFECT_BOUND
  "A save is not allowed for this machine, because its states are reached through declared events only."
  SAVE_NOT_ALLOWED
  "The client runs an older version of the machine than the server, and must reload."
  CLIENT_OUTDATED
  "The client runs a newer version of the machine than this server; a retry may reach a newer one."
  SERVER_OUTDATED
  "The user already holds as many drafts as one user may, so a start or a save creating another is refused."
  TOO_MANY_DRAFTS
  "The request id is missing, empty, whitespace, too long, or holds a character a row cannot store."
  INVALID_REQUEST_ID
  "The caller names no user, so there is no owner to act for."
  UNAUTHENTICATED
  "The machine declares no start, so a client cannot create an instance of it."
  NO_START
  "The instance belongs to the system: only host code creates, drives or deletes it."
  SYSTEM_OWNED
  """
  The caller has no instance with this id that it may read: a missing id, another user's, a system instance's,
  and one the read rule refuses the caller all get this one answer, so it tells the caller nothing about which.
  """
  NOT_FOUND
  "The caller already holds as many open subscriptions as one principal may; one that completes frees its place."
  TOO_MANY_SUBSCRIPTIONS
  "The client sent a twin's IR hash that differs from the machine this host serves; it must reload."
  SCHEMA_MISMATCH
  "The draft changed elsewhere while this write ran; reload and retry."
  CONFLICT
  "The machine declares no irreversible effect, so there is nothing to send."
  NO_EFFECT
  "The effect, or the store around it, failed: the draft was not advanced, so the caller can retry."
  DELIVERY_FAILED
  "The snapshot a client computed differs from the one the server computed for the same transition."
  CLIENT_DIVERGENCE
  "The state is completed by its action, not by a save: a client sends the action instead."
  STATE_RESERVED
  "The instance is in a state that invokes a train: it moves on when the train finishes, or through one of its actions, never through a save."
  DRAFT_INVOKING
  "The stored draft cannot be read by this machine definition, so only a start-over overwrites it."
  DRAFT_UNREADABLE
  "The draft was already completed, so an edit may not overwrite it."
  DRAFT_COMMITTED
  "The draft's action already ran on content that has changed since; its result is recorded only once that content is restored."
  DRAFT_CHANGED
  "The owner already has as many invoked runs live as one owner may, so the step that starts another is refused."
  INVOKE_LIMIT_REACHED
  "The user entering the state may not run the train it invokes."
  INVOKE_FORBIDDEN
  """
  An outcome or a timer would enter a state that invokes a train on a user-owned instance: only a system-owned
  instance chains runs that way.
  """
  INVOKE_CHAIN_USER_OWNED
}

"A typed problem returned as DATA from a mutation (never a thrown error across the API boundary)."
type SnapshotProblem {
  "The code a client branches on, such as UnknownMachine or NoTransition."
  code: RefusalCode!
  "A human-readable explanation for logs or display. Its wording is not a contract; branch on Code."
  message: String!
}

"The `UUID` scalar type represents a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) as defined by RFC 9562."
scalar UUID
  @specifiedBy(url: "https://scalars.graphql.org/chillicream/uuid.html")
